## Checklist

- [ ] One recipe in `library/`, named in lowercase with dashes
- [ ] `large_image` is set (an `icons/` name or an official `https://` link)
- [ ] If I added an icon: PNG, 512×512, the app's own unchanged icon or from a free icon theme
- [ ] `[match]` only fits this game/app (Steam games: exact `steam_appid`)
- [ ] Shows personal stuff (file names, projects, chats)? Then it has `default = "hidden"`
- [ ] Buttons only link to official pages
- [ ] I ran `python3 tools/build_index.py` and committed `library/index.json`
- [ ] I tested it with `omni status` and in Discord

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the details.
